tasks.title: Add core/gallery rules (cap of 20, evictionCandidates, entryName, touchedLabel, storageLine) and the STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE, STORAGE_FAILED and WORK_DAMAGED error codes
tasks.dod: Vitest (with property tests) proves evictionCandidates never picks the keep id, keeps the stored count at most 20, orders damaged first then oldest touchedAt with the id breaking ties, and adds `extra` more; touchedLabel gives Just now / N minutes ago / N hours ago / the Intl date at the 59 s, 60 s, 59 min, 60 min, 23 h 59 min and 24 h boundaries with an injected clock; entryName('') is Untitled; storageLine maps true / false / undefined; result.test covers the three new codes

tasks.title: Add core/gallery stored-Work rules: STORED_WORK_FORMAT, toStoredFields and validateStoredWork, refusing every damage kind as WORK_DAMAGED
tasks.dod: Vitest proves toStoredFields then validateStoredWork round-trips random valid Geometries, Adjustments, sizes, Source names and formats (property), and that a bad shape, a size outside 1..4096, a Crop outside the turned image, an Adjustment out of range, an unknown Source format, an unknown formatVersion and a layerId/layer mismatch each return WORK_DAMAGED

tasks.title: Promote migration 0002-gallery (works reshaped, originals, layers and meta stores), widen schema.ts to v2, untype Migration.upgrade, and add the db test fixtures
tasks.dod: The promoted migrations.test.ts proves a fresh database reaches v2 with the four stores and only the touchedAt index, a v1 database upgrades and is cleared, and every part of a Work plus the meta marker store and read back; 0001-init.ts is byte-for-byte unchanged and still compiles; workRecordFixture, storedWorkFixture and damagedWorkFixture exist in src/infra/db/testing.ts

tasks.title: Add storeWork to the works repository: evict and store in one read-write transaction over four stores, retry with one more eviction on a full quota, write the persistence marker on the first save
tasks.dod: Integration tests on fake-indexeddb with a fault wrapper prove: at 20 Works a first save evicts the oldest non-keep Work in the same commit and returns its name; quota errors on the first two attempts evict two and commit; quota on every attempt returns STORAGE_QUOTA with nothing evicted and the earlier state kept; an abort after the evictions, the record, the Original or the layer leaves the database exactly as before; a Work missing from the store is written back with Original and layer; the meta marker is written only when absent

tasks.title: Add listWorks, loadWork and deleteWork to the works repository: list newest first checking only shape and thumbnail, load every part, delete all parts in one transaction and refuse the open Work
tasks.dod: Integration tests prove listWorks returns records newest first by touchedAt (id breaks ties) and flags a bad shape or non-PNG thumbnail as damaged while a damaged Original still lists normally; loadWork returns record, Original and layer or WORK_DAMAGED for a missing part or a layerId/layer mismatch; deleteWork removes the id from works, originals and layers in one transaction, leaves other Works untouched, returns STORAGE_FAILED on an injected fault with nothing removed, and refuses the keep id

tasks.title: Open the Gallery database as a Result (refused, held by an older tab, closed for a newer version) with the versionchange hand-off, and add storage-persistence over navigator.storage
tasks.dod: Integration tests prove openGalleryDb returns STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE with reason 'refused' when open fails and 'held' after the bounded blocked wait, and that a second connection at the next version fires the onVersionChange callback on the first, which can then close; storage-persistence tests prove requestPersistence and isPersisted pass the browser's answer through and return false where navigator.storage or the method is missing

tasks.title: Add infra/work-codec: encodePng and decodePng in a fresh worker per job, with the decoded-size check
tasks.dod: worker-handler tests prove an opaque RGBA buffer encodes to a PNG Blob and decodes to the same bytes, and a decoded size different from the expected one, or an undecodable Blob, returns WORK_DAMAGED; client tests prove each job creates a fresh worker and terminates it on success, failure and timeout

tasks.title: Add renderThumbnail(work, maxSide) to the Preview renderer: the applied Work at fit, reduced in passes of at most 2:1, read back, Preview state restored
tasks.dod: Recording-GL tests prove renderThumbnail draws the applied Work (never a Draft) with its Geometry, Adjustments and layer into an offscreen framebuffer whose long side is 320 px for THUMBNAIL_LONG_SIDE, reduces by at most 2:1 per pass, returns an ImageData of that size, and restores the framebuffer, viewport and uniforms so the next Preview draw is unchanged; with the display lost it returns null

tasks.title: Extend Toast and useNotices with an optional action and returned ids, add the --gallery-tile-size token, and register both in the design system
tasks.dod: notices tests prove pushAll returns the new ids in order and dismiss(id) withdraws a failure notice; primitives tests prove a Toast with an action renders a ghost BaseButton before dismiss and running it calls run and dismisses the notice; tokens.css has --gallery-tile-size: 160px; docs/design-system.md lists the Toast action and the token

tasks.title: Add the Autosave save queue: single flight, latest wins, with saving, settled() and the last stored { workId, revision }
tasks.dod: Vitest property tests over random interleavings of requests and completions prove at most one save runs, the pending request is always the newest, saving is true exactly while one runs or waits, settled() resolves only when none remains, and the last stored revision is the newest successful one; a failed save leaves isStored(work) false

tasks.title: Compose autosave.ts: prepare the Original, layer and thumbnail PNGs, call storeWork, keep the encoded Blobs, ask for persistence once, react to versionchange, and raise the eviction, full-storage, failed-save and newer-version notices
tasks.dod: Integration tests with the real repository on fake-indexeddb, the codec handler called directly, the recording GL and a recording navigator.storage stub prove: the first save encodes the Original once, a Crop or Adjustment save encodes nothing and writes only the record, a drawing save encodes the layer; persist() is called once at the first save; one info notice names every evicted Work; STORAGE_QUOTA gives the full-storage failure notice; STORAGE_FAILED gives one withdrawable notice that a later success dismisses; unavailable makes every save a no-op; versionchange finishes the running save, drops the pending one, closes, marks unavailable and raises the newer-version notice

tasks.title: Wire Autosave into the editor store: save after replace, commit, undo and redo only; the replace gate waits for settled() and asks only when the latest state is unstored or the Gallery is unavailable; expose saving, galleryAvailable and openWorkId, and widen PanelId with 'gallery'
tasks.dod: Store tests on fake-indexeddb prove one save is queued after a successful replace, commit, undo and redo and none after opening a tool, a Draft change, zoom or pan; a cancelled or refused open stores and evicts nothing; with a save held the gate waits then replaces without asking; after a failed save, or a save that fails while waiting, or with the Gallery unavailable and Unsaved edits, the gate asks and Cancel keeps the Work, revision and Draft; existing open-and-view, crop-rotate and undo-redo store tests are changed deliberately, not loosened

tasks.title: Add reopenWork(id) to the editor store: refuse while exporting or confirming, load, decode and validate in full before the gate, replace with the stored Work, an empty Edit history and a fitted View
tasks.dod: Store tests prove reopenWork is refused and not queued while exporting or confirming; a damaged Work returns a damaged outcome and leaves the Work, revision, View and history unchanged with no confirmation; a readable Work replaces the open one keeping its id, Source name, Source format, Geometry and Adjustments, with a new layer id, empty history, revision === cleanRevision and a fitted View; the next Adjustment save encodes nothing; latest reopen wins; rejected bitmaps are closed

tasks.title: Add EditorView's start-screen and overlay slots and EditorTopBar's leading-actions slot, arm beforeunload only while saving, and reword ReplaceDialog
tasks.dod: EditorView tests prove the start-screen slot renders under EmptyCanvas with no Work, the overlay slot renders over the canvas area, leading-actions renders before Open image, and a beforeunload handler is added when saving turns true and removed when it turns false (none with Unsaved edits and no save); ReplaceDialog test shows Your latest edits aren't saved in the Gallery and will be lost., with Cancel, Esc and backdrop keeping the Work
